annotations.title: Best-value used cars in Ireland right now

description: Use when you want a ranked list of Irish used-car listings priced below the median of genuinely comparable cars (same make, model, fuel, transmission, within 1 year and 30,000 km). Each result includes the asking price, the market median, number of comparables and the gross margin. Best for dealers, flippers and buying agents looking for opportunities. Use get_new_deals instead for only recently discovered deals, or get_price_drops for listings where the seller has just reduced the asking price. Costs 0.05 USDC per call via x402; no-data results are free.

make.description: Only return this make, e.g. BMW.

min_margin_eur.description: Minimum margin in EUR between market median and asking price (after a cost buffer).
